Smt. Belmatiya vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:162925
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 35417 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Belmatiya
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Raksha Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Shri Shiv Singh Advocate, apprised the Court that today he has filed power on behalf of informant and, therefore, his name could not be shown in the cause list.
2.Heard Shri Ram Raksha Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Shiv Singh, learned counsel for the informant and Shri Rajiv Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State.

3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
75 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Naraini, District-Banda, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and her family members including her husband and son i.e., husband of the deceased and according to the FIR, marriage of the son of the applicant was performed with the deceased on 24.04.2021 and after marriage, applicant and her family members tortured her for a motorcycle and one lakh rupees and on 03.04.2023 informant received an information that applicant and her family members has committed the murder of his Smt. Belmatiya vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3142849/
1 daughter, i.e., deceased.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits, applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and totally on the basis of false allegation of torture and demand of dowry, applicant has made accused in the present matter along with other family members including her husband, i.e., father-in-law of the deceased.

6. He further submits that actually, son of the applicant i.e., husband of the deceased is heavily drunker and only due to this reason, some dispute arose between husband and wife and she committed suicide.
He next submits, post-mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

He further submits, bail application of Balveer Kushwaha i.e.,
father-in-law of the deceased has already been allowed by the coordinate Bench of this Court.
He produced the bail order of the father-in-law during the course of argument which is taken on record and marked as "A".
He further submits that applicant is a lady and she is in jail since 19.05.52023.

7. Per contra learned AGA as well as learned counsel appearing on behalf of informant opposed the prayer for bail and submits, applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and her daughter-in-law died under abnormal circumstances within two years of her marriage in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry, but both the counsel could not dispute the fact that she died due to hanging and there is no specific allegation against the applicant and father-in-law of the deceased has already been enlarged on bail by this Court.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. The applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased and although her daughter-in-law died in an abnormal circumstance in her matrimonial home within two years of marriage and there is also allegation of demand of dowry, but it appears that there is no specific allegation against the applicant and post-mortem report shows that deceased died due to hanging.
10.
Further, father-in-law of the deceased Balveer Kushwaha has already been released on bail by coordinate Bench of this Court and case of applicant is not distinguishable from him.

Further,
applicant is a lady and she is in jail since 19.05.2023.
11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Smt. Belmatiya be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
Smt. Belmatiya vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3142849/
2
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 11.8.2023 Vipasha  Smt. Belmatiya vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3142849/
